summary: The note is a short encyclopedia-style entry describing Kiri Territory, an administrative region in the Democratic Republic of the Congo. It places the territory within Mai-Ndombe District of Bandundu Province and names Kiri as its headquarters town.
one_line: Kiri Territory is an administrative region in Mai-Ndombe District, Bandundu Province, Democratic Republic of the Congo, headquartered in Kiri.
key_facts: Kiri Territory is an administrative region.
Kiri Territory is located in the Mai-Ndombe District.
Mai-Ndombe District is part of Bandundu Province.
Kiri Territory is located in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
The headquarters of Kiri Territory is the town of Kiri.
